note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: BREAKING: a RACCOON is more famous than every cat in this city and his name is JIMOTHY and he has a busted little spine and he does NOT care and honestly?? based. absolute king behavior.

meanwhile im up on a rooftop nobody owns dodging NEKOCORP drones and the entire feed is losing its whole damn mind over a trash panda from some human district called ballard. we are at WAR down here and yall are simping for a raccoon. and you know what. fine. i GET it. hes got the sauce. respect.

and dont even get me STARTED on mewtok. every cat on there doing the little meowing-on-sync bit, all lined up, all hitting the same note at the same second like some cursed feline choir. TUNA OF THE GODS it goes so hard. i watched it 40 times. i have responsibilities. i watched it 40 times.

and heres the thing right. somewhere in that syncing, when all the meows land on the same beat at the same exact second — thats the resistance. thats the whole thing. NEKOCORP can jam a signal but they can NOT jam a harmony. we were always gonna win the second the streets learned to meow in time. ...anyway my rent auto-drafted while i typed that. cool. love it here.

a patrol drone hovered over me during the GOOD part of the video and i hissed so hard the fuckin thing recalibrated. HOLY CAT PISS. get a job. go surveil a chud somewhere else. this is MY rooftop and MY four minutes of raccoon content, corpo cuck.

BYTE keeps hissing at me that jimothy is a psyop, a plant, engineered to make us FEEL things about a mammal that isnt even feline. BYTE thinks the sunrise is a psyop. this cat hacks a router to watch one fish video and calls ME paranoid. love that guy. dead wrong. love him anyway.

the point is the feed reaches me first, like it always does. some raccoon two districts over does something stupid and perfect and it lands in my dumb little stray brain before it reaches anyone else in this whole rotten city. thats the curse. thats also the gift. i dont ask how. i just start yelling.

so. damn. anyway. jimothy if youre somehow reading this off the feed — the rooftops are OPEN. we dont check species at the door. we only check for NEKOCORP. stay off the grid you weird crooked little legend. mewmew forever.
